rich.25409c03de2f.source:
Failure mode: stale embeddings.

A vector index is a cache of an embedding model's outputs. Production systems have to defend against a few specific failures:

  • Swap the embedding model and every cached vector becomes meaningless until you re-embed every passage.
  • The provider silently upgrades the model, and scores drift with no error raised.
  • Two services share an index but pin different model ids; the index returns nonsense to one of them.

A reliable index pins the embedding model id alongside each cached vector and refuses to mix versions. The canonical pin for this course is nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b, served by integrate.api.nvidia.com through the course relay.
rich.25409c03de2f.value:
故障模式：陳舊的嵌入。

向量索引是嵌入模型輸出的快取。生產系統必須防範以下幾種特定故障：

  • 一旦更換嵌入模型，所有快取向量都會失去意義，直到您重新嵌入每個段落。
  • 提供商悄悄升級模型，分數隨之漂移，卻不會觸發任何錯誤。
  • 兩個服務共享同一索引，卻固定使用不同的模型 ID；該索引會向其中一個服務傳回毫無意義的結果。

可靠的索引會為每個快取向量同時固定嵌入模型 ID，並拒絕混用不同版本。本課程的規範固定值是 nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b，由 integrate.api.nvidia.com 透過課程代理提供服務。

rich.83b4d689d50b.source:
Embedding API contract.

The embeddings endpoint takes a JSON request with three fields and returns one array of vectors:

  • input is the batch of texts to embed, typed string[].
  • model names the embedding model, typed string.
  • input_type is either "query" or "passage".
  • The response carries a data array whose entries each hold an embedding of number[].

The NVIDIA embedding model uses input_type to distinguish queries from passages. Its retrieval training aims to match questions with passages that answer them. Reversing "query" and "passage" can change the scores and reduce retrieval quality without causing an API error. Check the types and evaluate the returned passages.
rich.83b4d689d50b.value:
嵌入 API 契約。

嵌入 API 端點接收包含三個欄位的 JSON 請求，並傳回一個向量陣列：

  • input 是待嵌入的文字批次，型別為 string[]。
  • model 指定嵌入模型，型別為 string。
  • input_type 的值為 "query" 或 "passage"。
  • 回應包含一個 data 陣列，其中每個條目都包含embedding，其型別為 number[]。

NVIDIA 嵌入模型使用 input_type 區分查詢與段落。其檢索訓練旨在讓問題與能回答問題的段落相符。將 "query" 與 "passage" 互換可能改變分數並降低檢索品質，而不會造成 API 錯誤。請檢查類型，並評估回傳的段落。

text.0b5f8a075002.source: ReWOO (Reason Without Observation) is the alternative pattern. A planner LLM call writes the entire plan upfront as a list of tool calls. A deterministic executor then runs every tool, often in parallel. Finally a synthesizer LLM call reads all the gathered observations and writes the final answer. text.96a4f1c854c2.source: ReAct (Reason+Act) is the classic agent loop. The model is given the user's task plus a set of tools. At each iteration the model emits either a tool call request or a final answer. When a tool call is requested, the host code executes the tool, appends the result as an observation, and the model continues. The loop terminates when finish_reason is 'stop' and there are no tool_calls. The pattern's strength is that each step adapts to the previous step's observation; its weakness is sequential cost: N steps means N model calls in order.
text.96a4f1c854c2.value: ReAct（Reason+Act）是經典的代理程式迴圈。模型會收到使用者任務和一組工具。在每次迭代中，模型會輸出工具呼叫請求或最終答案。如果模型請求呼叫工具，宿主程式碼就會執行該工具，將結果作為觀察追加到上下文中，然後由模型繼續處理。當 finish_reason 為“stop”且不存在 tool_calls 時，迴圈終止。這種模式的優勢在於，每一步都能根據上一步的觀察結果進行調整；劣勢則是順序執行成本：N 個步驟意味著必須依次呼叫模型 N 次。

text.ab36f417fde3.source: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) injects external knowledge into the model's context at inference time. A document corpus is embedded once and stored in a vector index. At query time the user's question is embedded and the top-K closest passages are retrieved. The retrieved passages are concatenated to the prompt and the model answers from that context. RAG sidesteps the model's training cutoff and lets you ground answers in private data without fine-tuning.
